PNL-QL-150.template: A machine is purchased for ₹{purchasePrice}. The buyer spends ₹{repairExpense} on repairs, ₹{transportExpense} on transport and ₹{installationExpense} on installation. Find the effective cost of the machine.

PNL-QL-151.template: A trader purchases an article for ₹{purchasePrice}. Incidental expenses amount to {overheadPercent}% of the purchase price. Find the effective cost.

PNL-QL-152.template: An article is bought for ₹{purchasePrice} and ₹{expenses} is spent before sale. Find the selling price required to earn {profitPercent}% profit on the effective cost.

PNL-QL-153.template: A trader buys an article for ₹{purchasePrice} and incurs ₹{expenses} as additional expenses. At what price should it be sold if a loss of {lossPercent}% is accepted on the effective cost?

PNL-QL-154.template: An article is purchased for ₹{purchasePrice}, and additional expenses of ₹{expenses} are incurred. It is sold for ₹{sellingPrice}. Calculate the percentage gain or loss on the effective cost.

PNL-QL-155.template: An article is purchased for ₹{purchasePrice} and sold for ₹{sellingPrice}. Find the maximum additional expense that can be incurred while still obtaining {targetRatePercent}% {targetDirection} on the effective cost.

PNL-QL-156.template: A production batch costs ₹{totalInputCost} and contains {inputQuantity} units of material. If {wastedQuantity} units are wasted, find the effective cost per usable unit.

PNL-QL-157.template: A batch costing ₹{totalInputCost} contains {inputQuantity} units, of which {wastedQuantity} units are wasted. Find the selling price per usable unit required for an overall {targetRatePercent}% {targetDirection}.

PNL-QL-158.template: A manufacturer has a fixed cost of ₹{fixedCost}. The variable cost and selling price are ₹{variableCostPerUnit} and ₹{sellingPricePerUnit} per unit respectively. Find the minimum number of units required to break even.

PNL-QL-159.template: A manufacturer incurs a fixed cost of ₹{fixedCost}. Each unit costs ₹{variableCostPerUnit} to produce and sells for ₹{sellingPricePerUnit}. How many units must be sold to earn a profit of at least ₹{targetProfit}?

PNL-QL-160.template: A business has a fixed cost of ₹{fixedCost} and a variable cost of ₹{variableCostPerUnit} per unit. If {quantity} units are produced and sold, find the break-even selling price per unit.

PNL-QL-161.template: A trader buys one article for ₹{firstCostPrice} and sells it for ₹{firstSellingPrice}, incurring a loss. He buys another article for ₹{secondCostPrice}. At what price should the second article be sold so that the two transactions together result in neither profit nor loss?

PNL-QL-162.template: A trader buys one article for ₹{firstCostPrice} and sells it for ₹{firstSellingPrice}. He then buys another article for ₹{secondCostPrice}. Find the selling price of the second article required for an overall {targetRatePercent}% {targetDirection} across both transactions.

PNL-QL-163.template: The total amount realised from a commercial transaction is ₹{totalRecovery}, representing a {ratePercent}% {direction} on the effective cost. Find the effective cost.

PNL-QL-164.template: An asset is purchased for ₹{purchasePrice}. Flat expenses are {flatExpenses}, followed by an overhead of {overheadPercent}% calculated on {overheadBase}. Find the effective cost.

PNL-QL-165.template: An asset bought for ₹{purchasePrice} has an effective cost of ₹{effectiveCost}. Find the total additional expense included in its cost.

PNL-QL-166.template: An asset is bought for ₹{purchasePrice}, incurs flat expenses {flatExpenses}, and has an effective cost of ₹{effectiveCost}. If the remaining overhead is based on {overheadBase}, find its percentage.

PNL-QL-167.template: A factory spends ₹{rawMaterialCost} on material and ₹{labourCost} on labour. Factory overhead is {factoryOverheadPercent}% of prime cost, packaging costs ₹{packagingCost}, and scrap brings ₹{scrapRecovery}. For an output of {outputQuantity} units, find the net production cost.

PNL-QL-168.template: A factory uses material worth ₹{rawMaterialCost} and labour worth ₹{labourCost}. Factory overhead is {factoryOverheadPercent}% of prime cost, packaging costs ₹{packagingCost}, scrap recovery is ₹{scrapRecovery}, and output is {outputQuantity} units. Find the effective cost per unit.

PNL-QL-169.template: Material costing ₹{totalInputCost} consists of {inputQuantity} units. After {wastedQuantity} units are wasted, the waste is sold for ₹{scrapRecovery}. Find the effective cost per usable unit.

PNL-QL-170.template: A product breaks even at {breakEvenQuantity} units. Its variable cost is ₹{variableCostPerUnit} per unit and selling price is ₹{sellingPricePerUnit} per unit. Find the fixed cost.

PNL-QL-171.template: A business has fixed costs of ₹{fixedCost} and breaks even after selling {breakEvenQuantity} units at ₹{sellingPricePerUnit} each. Find the variable cost per unit.

PNL-QL-172.template: A business has fixed costs of ₹{fixedCost} and variable cost of ₹{variableCostPerUnit} per unit. At what price per unit should {quantity} units be sold to earn ₹{targetProfit}?

PNL-QL-173.template: A business has fixed costs of ₹{fixedCost} and a contribution-margin ratio of {contributionMarginPercent}%. Find its break-even revenue.

PNL-QL-174.template: A business has fixed costs of ₹{fixedCost} and break-even revenue of ₹{breakEvenRevenue}. Find the contribution-margin ratio.

PNL-QL-175.template: A business sells products in the fixed mix {productMix}. If its fixed cost is ₹{fixedCost}, find the minimum number of complete product-mix bundles required to break even.

PNL-QL-176.template: Actual revenue is ₹{actualRevenue} and break-even revenue is ₹{breakEvenRevenue}. Find the margin of safety in rupees.

PNL-QL-177.template: Actual revenue is ₹{actualRevenue}, while break-even revenue is ₹{breakEvenRevenue}. Find the margin-of-safety percentage on actual revenue.

PNL-QL-178.template: The total effective cost of several commercial transactions is ₹{totalCost}. Earlier recoveries are {priorRecoveries}. Find the final recovery required to obtain an overall {targetRatePercent}% {targetDirection}.

PNL-QL-179.template: A trader loses {lossPercent}% of his capital. What profit percentage on the remaining capital is required to restore the original capital?

PNL-QL-180.template: An article has an effective cost of ₹{effectiveCost} and is sold for ₹{grossSellingPrice}. A commission of {commissionPercent}% is deducted from the selling price. Find the profit or loss amount and percentage.

PNL-QL-181.template: An article has an effective cost of ₹{effectiveCost}. A commission of {commissionPercent}% will be deducted from the gross selling price. Find the gross price required for {targetRatePercent}% {targetDirection} on effective cost.

PNL-QL-182.template: The manufacturing table gives material, labour, overhead and packaging costs: {manufacturingTable}. If output is {outputQuantity} units and scrap recovery is ₹{scrapRecovery}, find the effective cost per unit.

PNL-QL-183.template: Read the break-even caselet: {caseletData}. Using fixed cost ₹{fixedCost} and product mix {productMix}, find the minimum number of complete bundles required to break even.

PNL-QL-184.template: After a loss of {lossPercent}% of capital, select the correct statement about the profit percentage required on the remaining capital to recover the original amount.

PNL-QL-185.template: The purchase price is {purchasePriceExpression}, flat expense is {flatExpenseExpression}, and effective cost is {effectiveCostExpression}. If overhead is calculated on {overheadBase}, find the overhead percentage.

PNL-QL-186.template: To determine the break-even quantity, consider Statement I: {statementOne}. Statement II: {statementTwo}. Decide whether either statement alone or both together are sufficient.
